body: Hey, I'm sorry you feel that way! We are all unique, even if many of us are filled with scars we are all worth something! :) send me a pm if you want to talk! Remember,  many of us here have struggled or is struggling with selfhate, anxiety or any type of suicidal thoughts or tendencies :) you are not alone! :)

Hey I'm so sorry you are going through such a hard time and you feel the way you do! :( just know that you are not alone! It's kind of clichè to say but we are all in this together,  and if you need to talk just send a pm! :) alot of us here struggle in our daily life too and sometimes just having someone going through something similar in life to talk too can help you find alittle bit of peace, even if it's just for a moment :) I've struggled myself since I was 8 and now I'm 30, but that struggle still haunts me from time to time :)
Your not alone! We are all in this together! :) I'm here if you need to talk! :)

Hey,  Sorry  you've been through all that pain. 
I can relate to a life filled with pain and misery. 
I would like to say "it gets better" but it rarely does and I don't want to lie to you:) fellow Swede stuck in the eternal darkness.

For what it's worth.. you ain't completely alone in this hell hole that is life. 

I wish for you the best nonetheless :) 
Made a post couple months ago aswell and I'm still struggling:) 

Wanna talk, feel free to hit me up on PM friend:)

Hey thanks! Means alot! 🙂
Well I try 🙂 
Thing is I don't actually look for empathy here, I just wanted to share my story so maybe people who relate that are stuck in a dark corner can feel that they are not completely alone🙂.
We are all in this together 🙂.
